question: Which seed syllables provide constant protection for the shoulders and arms?
premises: Śrīṃ is invoked to protect the shoulders surely.
Hrīṃ is invoked to protect the arms.
The protection of the arms is requested always.
inference: Śrīṃ and hrīṃ are assigned to guard the shoulders and arms continuously.
plain_english: May śrīṃ surely protect the shoulders; may hrīṃ always protect the arms.
